title.tl: Ang Aking Propeta ay si Muhammad ﷺ

text.ar:
مُحَمّد ﷺ الرحمة المهداة
هو محمد بن عبدالله ﷺ خاتم الأنبياء والمرسلين، أرسله الله تعالى بدين الإسلام إلى الناس كافَّة، ليدلهم على الخير وأعظمه التوحيد، وينهاهم عن الشر وأعظمه الشرك.
تجبُ طاعته فيما أمر وتصديقه فيما أخبر، واجتناب ما نهى عنه وزجر، وألَّا يُعبد الله إلا بما شرع.
رسالته ورسالة جميع الأنبياء من قبله الدعوة إلى عبادة الله وحده لا شريك له.
text.en:
Muhammad (pbuh), the Prophet of mercy
He is Muhammad ibn ‘Abdullāh, the final Prophet and Messenger. Allah Almighty sent him with the religion of Islam to all humankind to guide them to all that is good, the greatest of which is monotheism; and to warn them against all that is evil, the worst of which is polytheism.
It is an obligation to obey his orders, believe what he said, avoid what he forbade or warned against, and worship Allah only in the manner that he prescribed.
His message and the message of all the prophets before him was to call for the worship of Allah alone without a partner.
text.tl:
Si Muhammad ﷺ, Ang Habag
Siya si Muhammad ﷺ na anak ni Abdullah, ang panghuling Propeta at Sugo. Ipinadala siya ng Allah na dala ang relihiyong Islam para sa buong sangkatauhan upang ituro sa kanila ang daan ng kabutihan, at ang pinakamainam dito ay ang Tawheed o ang kaisahan ng Allah; at upang ipagbawal sa kanila ang daan ng kasamaan, at ang pinakamasama dito ay ang pagtatambal sa Tunay na Nag-iisang Diyos, Allah.

text.ar:
من صفاته ﷺ:
الصدق، الرحمة، الحِلم، الصبر، الشجاعة، الكرم، حسن الخلق، العدل، التواضع، العفو.
text.en:
Some of his traits:
Honesty, mercy, forbearance, patience, bravery, generosity, good manners, fairness, modesty, and forgiveness.
text.tl:
Kabilang sa kanyang mga katangian:
Makatotohanan,
mahabagin,
maunawain,
mapagtimpi,
matapang,
mapagbigay,
may magandang asal,
makatarungan,
mapagkumbaba,
mapagpatawad, at ibapa.

text.ar: يعرف أن محمدًا ﷺ خاتم الأنبياء والمرسلين، أرسله الله بالإسلام إلى الناس كافة
text.en: Knows that Muhammad ﷺ is the final Prophet and Messenger, sent with Islam to all humankind
text.tl: Alam na si Muhammad ﷺ ang panghuling Propeta at Sugo, na ipinadala dala ang Islam para sa buong sangkatauhan

text.ar: يعرف أن أعظم الخير الذي دلّ عليه التوحيد، وأعظم الشر الذي نهى عنه الشرك
text.en: Knows that the greatest good he guided to is monotheism and the worst evil he warned against is polytheism
text.tl: Alam na ang pinakamainam na kabutihan na itinuro niya ay ang Tawheed at ang pinakamasamang kasamaan ay ang pagtatambal
